summary: Decoded karma-roll routine at wpcmk.ovr file offset 0x3837. Formula: karma = rng(19) + optional +1 if personality-confirm flag [DGROUP 0x560e] == 1. Range 0..18 normally; 1..19 if player actively confirmed personality roll. Cross-validated against all 6 stock characters in pcfile.dbs.

findings.claim: Karma is rolled via rng(19) — uniform 0..18 — stored at DGROUP 0x55a3

disassembly: a2 a3 55    ; mov [0x55a3], al   ; store karma byte

findings.claim: If [DGROUP 0x560e] == 1, karma gets +1 (inc byte [0x55a3]). Flag is set when player actively confirms personality roll instead of timing out.

disassembly: fe 06 a3 55     ; inc byte [0x55a3]   ; +1 to karma

findings.claim: Karma range is 0..18 without confirm flag, 1..19 with confirm flag. Values 0..19 are all reachable; no dead zones.

evidence.notes: rng(19) yields uniform 0..18 (the engine's rng_thunk returns 0..ax-1)

findings.claim: All 6 stock characters in pcfile.dbs have karma values in the reachable range 0..19

evidence.notes: Values decoded from pcfile.dbs slot records at the karma byte offset per the character-record schema

findings.claim: DGROUP 0x55a3 is the karma byte in the in-progress character record during creation. DGROUP 0x560e is the personality-confirm flag (cleared to 0 after use).

evidence.notes: Addresses appear in the verified bytes at 0x3837..0x384c. The flag at 0x560e is set by the click/RETURN handler in the personality-reroll idle loop; the inc at 0x55a3 and the subsequent clear of 0x560e both appear in the same code path.

unresolved: The exact DGROUP layout during character creation (which byte is Karma vs. Personality in the 8-attribute block at 0x559c..0x55a3) — see wpcmk-character-creation.md for the ambiguity. The binary evidence places karma at 0x55a3 but the attribute ordering note says 'exact name assignment is unverified.'

Whether the personality-confirm flag at 0x560e is ever set by a non-interactive path (e.g., a developer cheat similar to the bonus-point debug flag at 0x56ce). No evidence found; assumption is flag is only set by user interaction.
